protocol.input: Identical authored supported-source corpus and literal query; no oracle paths, no follow-up query rewriting.
protocol.output_budget: Each arm gets the same maximum complete UTF-8 serialized-output bytes, including newline, paths, metadata, discovery and selection. Original question/query is shared input, not counted for any arm.
protocol.literal_files: Independent casefold substring discovery over sorted complete source files. Whole matching files only; 32 candidates, five selected max. Discovery path and source-sha256 overhead included in output. No truncation to favor a required literal; files that do not fit are omitted.
protocol.measurement: Literal witnesses at specified locations, not generated answers, semantic correctness, tokens, prices or savings. Absence is a separate literal control.
protocol.order: Rotate three arm orders by question; no repeated timing conclusions. Cold index build and source bytes are reported separately.
protocol.freeze: Written and SHA-256 fixed before any new corpus indexing/query; results cannot change queries, budget or rubric.
protocol.bias: Prospective held-out outputs on fresh authored sources, but task families informed by prior audit. Not blind, representative, external, randomized or an agent study.
